info.title: OpenConferences Bot API
info.description: Conference-scoped reads, explicitly granted assignment coordination, and reviewer invitation lifecycle/batch operations. Existing keys retain their original permissions. All response timestamps are UTC. Names and contacts are omitted without explicit identity/contact scopes. Review content, scores, conflict details, payments, files and other mutations are excluded. Invitation tokens appear only inside shareable invitation URLs, which require explicit invitation scopes and organizer authorization. Each read page is a consistent snapshot; different pages may observe concurrent updates. A missing historical submittedAt is null, not an estimate. Bearer credentials are shown only once by the human management API.

BotKey.description: ocbot_v1.<public-key-id>.<secret>; expires in at most 90 days. One conference per key. Never pass keys in query strings.
